    • createSubTree

      public GameTree createSubTree​(GameTreeNode newRoot)
      Creates a new GameTree object that is a copy of this one starting at the given root.
      The GameStates stored in this object will be deep-copied, even if the selected newRoot is equal to this root.
      Nodes from the sub-tree are not interchangable with nodes from the original tree, nor are their GameStates, although the GameState.contentEquals(Object) would be true for matching elements.
      There is no reflection of changes in either direction: changes in this GameTree do not affect the sub-tree and changes in the sub-tree do not change this GameTree
      Parameters:
      newRoot -
      Returns:
      null if the given new root is not an element of this GameTree

    • getAllPossibleMoves

      public java.util.List<Move> getAllPossibleMoves​(GameState state, java.util.function.Function<Pawn,​java.lang.Boolean> post_filter)
      Parameters:
      state - The GameState for which to compute all moves
      post_filter - a filter that assigns a boolean value to each of the pawns in the GameState; essentially pruning which pawns are allowed to add the resulting GameStates from their moves to the GameTree
      Returns:
      returns a list of all moves executable by the current player in the given GameState filtered by pawns that satisfy the filter

      public java.util.List<GameTreeNode> expand​(int depth, java.util.function.Function<GameState,​java.lang.Boolean> pre_filter, java.util.function.Function<Pawn,​java.lang.Boolean> post_filter)
      expand all nodes at a given depth that satisfy the given pre-filter and add all nodes that satisfy the given post-filter
      Parameters:
      depth -
      pre_filter - a filter that limits which nodes will be expanded based on the returnvalue of the pre_filter

      the list of nodes that were added to the GameTree
